Seahawk Investments GmbH launched the Seahawk Maritime Credit Fund, targeting $150M with ~$80M anchored, pursuing senior secured, asset-backed loans; leverage up to 1:1 allowed.

# Detail AI Analyst View 1 New maritime private credit fund Expands revenue streams into illiquid credit with fee potential. 2 Target size $150M; ~$80M anchored Over half pre-committed de-risks first close and deployment. 3 Leverage permitted up to 1:1 Enables up to $300M total credit exposure; boosts fees/returns. 4 Senior secured, asset-backed focus Lower loss-given-default profile may stabilize performance. 5 8-year max term + 2x1-year options Signals long-duration, locked capital and fee visibility. 6 Ability to structure financial leases Wider toolkit may win deals and pricing in niche markets.

This is an early-stage expansion into maritime private credit, adding a third pillar to Seahawk’s platform. A meaningful catalyst would be rapid capital raise to the $150M target and evidence of deployment yields/default metrics on initial loans.

Based on the original press release from Seahawk Investments GmbH distributed by EQS.
